[u][i][b]How to visit Island on this Mod.
[/b][/i][/u]
Ginger Island is reachable by boat inside fishshop.
Ginger Island can also be reached by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]. I've included an optional "warps.json" that adds a warp to
Island.  This file would replace the default "warps.json".
